```{r, include = FALSE}

```

Gaussian uses ALS; Poisson / Bernoulli use PIRLS + weighted TT-ALS.

```{r}
# ttpspline(y, X, family = poisson(),  rank = 3, lambda = 1)
# ttpspline(y, X, family = binomial(), rank = 3, lambda = 1)
```

Automatic λ: `lambda = "cGCV"`. Paper 2 will add `"cFS"` / `"cREML"` via the
same argument.
